title: 第19章  山神庙养尸地
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
李青挣扎着爬起来，咳出一大口黑血。

    赵平抓着刀柄，看着眼前两个灰袍人，眼神狠厉。

    “长生教的狗崽子，终于肯露面了。”

    “林杨，一人一个。”

    话音落下，两人提刀杀向面前两个灰袍人。

    林杨一个突进，手中横刀斩出一道凛冽刀罡，毫不留情地砍向灰袍人的脑袋。

    灰袍人身影一闪，下一刻，一只苍白的手抓住了他的脖子。

    微微用力，就令他感到难以呼吸。

    “给我死！”

    赵平大喝一声，向着另一个灰袍人杀去。

    那人冷哼一声，灰袍之下打出一只墨黑符箓。

    符箓之上乌光大盛，激射而出，瞬间印在赵平胸口。

    赵平就像是被一股巨力击中，身体倒飞而出，接连撞倒好几棵大树。

    他艰难坐起身，胸口的墨黑符印还泛着乌光。

    浓烈尸毒涌向心口，迅速向着体内渗透。

    他连忙调动灵力护住心脉，“长生教，歪门邪道，若不是老子被尸傀所伤，一刀就能砍死你们两个！”

    灰袍人脸上露出一抹残忍笑意，“死到临头你还嘴硬？”

    眼看苍白五指抓向自己咽喉，赵平心中已经萌生死念。

    突然，一道细微的破空声穿梭而来。

    嚓！

    一道三寸长的锋棱晶刺瞬间洞穿了灰袍人胸膛。

    鲜血咳出，那人难以置信地低下头。

    “这......这是？”

    下一刻，又是一道晶刺袭来，瞬间射爆了灰袍人脑袋。

    温热的血浆洒在赵平身上，就在他愣神之际，一道身影出现在了另一个灰袍人面前。

    那人脸色一紧，猛地将林杨甩开，脸上一副如临大敌的姿态。

    “你是何方宵小？”

    陆渊直接笑了，“我何方宵小？你他妈倒反天罡！”

    虽说陆渊没有斩妖刀，但这一身墨黑暗纹锦袍可是镇魔卫的标配服饰。

    你不认识人，连衣服也不认识？

    对于这种蠢人，陆渊打算送他一程。

    抬手飞出一道晶刺，光痕闪过，那人头颅直接炸开。

    赵平和林杨互相对视一眼，眼中露出一抹疑惑。
content_en:
Li Qing struggled to get up and coughed up a large mouthful of black blood.

    Zhao Ping grabbed the handle of the knife and looked at the two gray-robed men in front of him with stern eyes.

    "The bastard of the Immortality Cult is finally willing to show up."

    "Lin Yang, one for each person."

    After the words fell, the two men raised their knives to kill the two men in gray robes in front of them.

    Lin Yang rushed forward, slashed out a sharp blade with the sword in his hand, and struck the gray-robed man's head mercilessly.

    The figure of the man in gray robe flashed, and the next moment, a pale hand grabbed his neck.

    The slightest exertion made it difficult for him to breathe.

    "Die!"

    Zhao Ping shouted loudly and charged towards the other gray-robed man.

    The man snorted coldly and pulled out a black talisman from under his gray robe.

    The black light on the talisman flourished, shot out, and was instantly imprinted on Zhao Ping's chest.

    Zhao Ping seemed to be hit by a huge force, and his body flew out, knocking down several big trees one after another.

    He sat up with difficulty, the black talisman on his chest still glowing.

    The strong corpse poison rushed to his heart and quickly penetrated into his body.

    He quickly mobilized his spiritual power to protect his heart, "The Immortality Sect is a crooked way. If I hadn't been injured by the corpse puppet, I could have killed both of you with one knife!"

    A cruel smile appeared on the face of the man in gray robe, "You are still stubborn when you are about to die?"

    Seeing the pale fingers clawing at his throat, Zhao Ping already had thoughts of death in his heart.

    Suddenly, a subtle sound broke through the air.

    Crack!

    A three-inch long sharp crystal thorn instantly pierced the gray-robed man's chest.

    Coughing out blood, the man lowered his head in disbelief.

    "This...is this?"

    The next moment, another crystal thorn struck, instantly exploding the gray-robed man's head.

    Warm plasma was sprinkled on Zhao Ping's body. Just as he was dazed, a figure appeared in front of another man in gray robe.

    The man's face tightened, and he suddenly threw Lin Yang away, with an expression on his face as if he was facing a formidable enemy.

    "Who are you, Fang Xiaoxiao?"

    Lu Yuan laughed directly, "Why am I so young? You're fucking against Tiangang!"

    Although Lu Yuan did not have a demon-slaying sword, this dark brocade robe with black patterns was the standard attire of the Demon Suppressing Guard.

    You don’t know the person, not even the clothes?

    For such a fool, Lu Yuan planned to give him a ride.

    Raising his hand, a crystal thorn flew out, a trace of light flashed past, and the man's head exploded.

    Zhao Ping and Lin Yang looked at each other, with a hint of doubt in their eyes.
title_en: Chapter 19 Mountain Temple Corpse Raising Ground
